purpose: Qualify unchanged alignment-v3 runtime at the maximum planned native-rate geometry and localize elapsed time without accessing real audio or changing scientific thresholds.

construction.generator: Unsigned 32-bit LCG: seed 0x35A719C3; state = (1664525*state+1013904223) modulo 2^32. For each pair index i, generate a,b as (((state>>16) modulo 1024)-512)*32*(1+(i//137) modulo 5)/2^20. Left extends (a,b), right extends (-b,a). Truncate to 576008 frames. Inputs are immutable tuples, not file-backed waveforms.
construction.identity: Exact constructed stereo reference versus itself, with the same recipe identity in uninstrumented and instrumented modes.
construction.constant_envelope: Both channels are the exact constant 0.125; centered Pearson envelope evidence is undefined and should abstain.
construction.topology_mismatch: Constructed stereo reference versus its left channel declared mono; topology rejection should occur without channel alignment.
construction.selection: One deterministic artificial active family plus two invalid-support controls. No source representativeness or exhaustive algorithm qualification claim.

timing_contract.baseline: Uninstrumented call to the unchanged alignment implementation, with a 180-second SIGALRM alignment deadline.
timing_contract.instrumentation: Reversible wrappers around channel, envelope, correlation, gain and drift/structural audit calls. Charge exclusive perf_counter time and count stage entries/completions; the alarm saves its active stage stack. Delegate every operation, lag and argument unchanged. Do not use per-line or all-function profiling.
timing_contract.measurement_boundary: Input construction, import, process startup and result serialization are outside the isolated alignment timer. Each entire worker has a separate 210-second parent timeout. Passing 180 seconds here is necessary but insufficient for a full codec pipeline sharing that budget.
timing_contract.censoring: A timeout is a right-censored runtime with no completed alignment record. The observed stack localizes interruption, not the time for unexecuted channels or a completed-run hotspot. Partial counts and timing fields may differ between rounds.
timing_contract.replay: Run the four cases in the listed order twice, each in a fresh isolated process, one worker. Keep both reports unchanged. Compare case outcomes and any completed numerical alignment bytes separately; do not demand byte-identical clocks, counters or deadline locations.
timing_contract.clock_policy: No post-observation deadline increase, narrowed lag search, signal replacement, case substitution or automatic retry. This does not change the prior real-audio result.
timing_contract.primary_feasibility: Report whether uninstrumented identity completes within 180 seconds in both rounds. A failure rejects current full-rate execution feasibility on this construction; it is not a scientific alignment-support or perceptual-quality rejection.

execution_boundary.publication: Commit the tested protocol locally before full-size alignment observation. Publish the protocol and subsequent result commits together only after full local CI-equivalent checks, then verify exact final-head CI. Synthetic-only development does not claim prior external preregistration.
execution_boundary.native_runtime: Verify the previously bound installed native closure metadata before execution, each round and after execution. No encode/decode calls are made. Tests on other hosts use constructed small inputs and mocked runtime gates.
execution_boundary.resource: One worker; 15 GiB disk reserve before construction; fixed maximum input shape; at most eight 210-second worker processes. No encoded/decoded audio, external input or waveform storage. Capture is from the bound worker only; validate its JSON size and schema.
execution_boundary.retention: A new unique directory outside Git retains execution.json, round-1.json, round-2.json and result.json. Files are no-clobber JSON with mode 0600, directory 0700. Publish only audited synthetic result objects, with no local paths or raw sample arrays.

expected_guard_behavior.constant_envelope: unsupported, no_valid_coarse_correlation, all common summary fields unavailable
expected_guard_behavior.topology_mismatch: unsupported, channel_topology_mismatch and channel_map_mismatch, no channel alignment records

next_action: If full-rate feasibility fails, preserve this result and use measured stage localization to design a separately versioned optimization with semantic-equivalence evidence. No optimization or real-data rerun is implicitly accepted by this result.
